Exam-like papers

Written for this app in the style of the CSSE maths paper: about 20 questions, 60 marks, 60 minutes, no calculator. Pencil and paper ready.

Past papers

Real CSSE papers come from CSSE, the organisation that sets the Essex 11+. Print one, do it on paper in 60 minutes with no calculator, mark it with the answers, then record the score below. It then counts towards the estimated exam score.

  • CSSE 11+ Examination page – free familiarisation papers and guidance for parents
  • CSSE Maths familiarisation paper (PDF) – free, from the CSSE website
  • Order CSSE practice packs of past papers – from CSSE; free for children receiving free school meals (with a letter from their primary school)

This app is not connected with or endorsed by CSSE.

Other free resources

  • Atom Learning: free 11+ baseline test and free course – free sign-up
  • Atom Learning: free 11+ worksheets
